Study Abroad

The Global Semester program sends students to partner universities in 40 countries, and credits transfer back automatically.

Financial aid travels with you, so a semester abroad costs about the same as a semester on campus.

Advisors help each student choose a program that fits their major, and most programs need no knowledge of a second language.

Short-term programs over winter and summer breaks are open to students who can't spend a full semester away.
